review.feedback: Blocking: draft readback does not verify that remote['id'] equals the journaled workflow_id. verify_remote checks only a nonempty ID and matching name; the protected acceptance test likewise checks only a nonempty ID. A details response carrying another ID but the expected name and graph can pass, causing evidence and reviewed_version to reference the wrong resource. Require exact ID equality before executions or review, and add a regression proving mismatched readback IDs block without a checkpoint. Supplied tests pass; deferred publication and the pending live pilot are not defects.
